sections.label: Overview
sections.title: A clear beginning.
sections.body: Give each chapter a useful name. This reading surface is a working example: scroll to see the line follow your position, or choose a chapter above to jump directly to its content.

sections.label: Process
sections.title: Move with intention.
sections.body: The whole label row is clickable. The thin line underneath only reports real reading progress. It moves backward when you scroll upward, and never acts as a scrubber.

sections.label: Details
sections.title: Keep the reader in control.
sections.body: A new destination replaces the previous one. Wheel, touch and scrolling keys interrupt the transition. Keyboard focus arrives with the content; reduced motion moves there immediately.
